endorsements.quote: we trained our end users (clinicians) in the interpretation of AI predictions and feature attributions, as well as in dealing with biases (see Section 4.2)
Instead of visualizing the LOS prediction without any further information, we decided to add feature importance values, that highlight which features have been relevant for the individual prediction.
Thus, we address stakeholder desiderata and avoid misconceptions of XAI methods.

unlisted_practices: Embed ethicists within AI development teams from the outset to surface ethical blind spots and foster interdisciplinary dialogue.
Combine embedded ethics with explainable AI so that ethical concerns are translated into concrete technical system design.
Develop XAI literacy among clinicians, meaning the competence to critically evaluate explanation outputs and recognize their limitations.

screen.reason: The paper provides an empirical qualitative case study evaluating the implementation of an Embedded Ethics (EE) framework and explainable AI (XAI) as governance/collaboration practices during the development of an ICU clinical decision support system (KISIK project).

primary.practice: embedded ethics framework and XAI interface
